dialogues.speaker: Ziwei
dialogues.text: It is! Look, this one is called "Fungora Boareas..." Get it? Because it looks like a boar digging for mushrooms.

dialogues.speaker: Ziwei
dialogues.text: And this one is "Geo Lord Versus Bovine Beast." Look, look, here's the cow's head... and here's his horns...

response.speaker: Ziwei
response.text: Look harder... And this one! So this one is "Frosted Jade Crystal Vase with Mother-of-Pearl Inlay, Inlaid with Pearls..." Isn't it the spitting image!?

response.speaker: Ziwei
response.text: That's normal if you're not versed in astronomy. To be fair, it does require a certain grasp of the basics to appreciate the secrets of the stars and their patterns.

response.speaker: Ziwei
response.text: If you're really interested, I'd recommend that you read the column about constellations in The Steambird.

response.speaker: Ziwei
response.text: Ever since Astrologist Mona Megistus took over that column, she'll often write some very interesting things.

response.speaker: Ziwei
response.text: Even though I don't entirely get it myself, it is rather fascinating! I will definitely continue supporting her!
